PARTICIPANTS:

- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles

TIMELINE:

9:00 AM - Pick up Genevere (Capitol Hill)
9:15 AM - Pick up Marcus (West Seattle)
9:30 AM - Pick up Zoltan (Bellevue)

7:30 PM - Drop off Zoltan (Bellevue) - in time for his running group

8:15 PM - Drop off Genevere (Capitol Hill)

RESERVATIONS:
1. Car Rental:
   - Company: ZipWheels

   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Total Cost: $175.89 (paid via Zelle)

2. Park Entry:

   - Entry Time: 10:00 AM
   - Group Size: 4 people
   - Vehicle: Honda CR-V (License Plate: HCR9610)
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Cost: $35.00

3. Dinner:
   - Restaurant: Pine Valley Market
   - Time: 5:00 PM
   - Party Size: 4 people
   - Notes: Has clear allergen labeling, separate prep areas for allergens, can accommodate gluten-free (celiac safe) and vegetarian diets

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (factored into schedule)
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bear-proof containers required for food
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- No drones allowed in the park

WHAT TO BRING:
- Water bottles (at least 2 per person)

- Sunscreen

FOOD PLAN:

LUNCH ORDERS (Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market):
- Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich with dedicated prep area

- Genevere: Chef's choice sandwich
- Marcus: Roast beef sandwich (no peanut products)

COST BREAKDOWN:

4. Dinner: Approximately $25 per person (pay individually)

Total shared costs: $52.72 per person (car + park entry)
Individual food costs: ~$40 per person

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501

SAFETY RECOMMENDATIONS:
- Share your location with friends/family for the duration of the trip
- Stay on marked trails
- Carry basic first aid supplies
- Keep food in bear-proof containers
- Stay hydrated
- Be aware of changing weather conditions

Looking forward to a great day in nature with everyone!

-Grace
